nodes.label: Lexicon build-monitor orchestrator checkpoint
nodes.rationale: The build monitor is complete. A worker thread and queue.SimpleQueue let the default Textual monitor render progress while build work runs; cancel rolls back and exits 130. --no-tui is the plain renderer and --quiet prints only the final summary. Forms and search keys were locked to TEMP staging tables at this checkpoint.

nodes.label: TEMP lexicon staging tables
nodes.rationale: The build-monitor checkpoint locks forms and search keys to stream through TEMP tables. The later slice-1 handoff says the rebuild path has no TEMP staging tables and no sqlite3.connect. The checkpoint file itself was not revised.

nodes.label: Lexicon build-monitor TUI
nodes.rationale: The default interactive lexicon build path uses a Textual monitor fed by a worker thread and queue.SimpleQueue. Event models live in wyrdcraeft/models/lexicon_build.py. --no-tui selects the plain renderer.
